title: Add Default Model Client in AGS
body:
Add Default Model Client in AGS that can be used for several house keeping issues e.g,

- Automatically summarise the session title in playground #3515 
- Automatically generate components (future capability)

## How 

- Add as feature to app settings in DB 
- Allow users view/modify default model in settings
